name: Methane (CH4), burner fuel gas
source: CH4 molar mass 16.043 g/mol from IUPAC standard atomic weights (C 12.011, H 1.008 x4). C fraction 12.011/16.043 = 74.8675%.
notes: Pipeline natural gas is treated here as pure methane, the dominant component; trace ethane, propane and inert gases are not modelled separately. C is rounded to the nearest microgram and H closes the two-element compound exactly. Combustion (CH4 + 2 O2 -> CO2 + 2 H2O) is a burner process elsewhere that must draw O2 from atmosphere and post CO2 and H2O back to it.
